INTRO: ^The Gardener glances at you as you approach, the grass-green eyes beneath a brown straw hat keenly watching. Suddenly, she holds out her hand as if to warn you. "Watch where you step." Her voice is melodious yet firm.
KEEP_WALKING: ^You almost scoff under your breath at the Gardener's pretentiousness. Who does she think she is? Disregarding her worries, you continue walking at your leisure.
^Before long, you hear a terrible crunch beneath your foot.
^You stop. Something cold brushes against your ankle.
^A flower lies crushed beneath your shoe.
^It is unlike anything you have seen before. Its petals are translucent, almost weightless, and they seem to contain a faint green light. Even broken, the flower continues to glow.
^For a moment, an image seems to appear from within it. A sphere. A night sky. An eye. Then the image fractures into countless points of light.
^She is staring at the remains beneath your foot. Her expression has completely changed: the warmth has left her face.
^The Gardener immediately kneels beside the crushed flower. She does not look at you as she carefully gathers the broken petals between her fingers.
^Her fingers tremble slightly as she examines what remains.
^Her voice is controlled now, but there is unmistakable anger beneath it.
^You look down at the darkened petals.
^She looks back at the place where it had grown.
^"Something Ossaneth saw. Something it experiences. Someone that it knew."
^"Do not." The Gardener rises. "You did not know what they were. I understand that. But you were told to watch where you stepped, and you chose not to."
^She looks past you, towards the path you took.
^"These memories are precious. Some of them are older than either of us. Some are the only record that certain things ever happened."
^"Do you understand what you have done?"
^You glance at the dead flower. "I didn't mean to—"
^"But that does not bring it back." For a few moments, neither of you speaks.
^The Gardener finally exhales and looks away.

^She kneels once more, placing the remains carefully into the soil. You hear her mutter under her breath: "The Keeper and Ossaneth... they will not be happy. It is unfortunate such a person has been chosen."
^When she stands, some of her anger has subsided, but she remains visibly upset.
^She gestures towards the clear patch of ground beside her.
^The Gardener watches your feet until you reach her.
^But she turns towards you, leaving enough space for you to stand beside her.
WATCH_STEP: ^"Sure, I can do that," you say.
^You continue towards the Gardener, this time keeping your eyes fixed on the ground.
^A faint, pale-green glow shines between two blades of grass.
^You stop your foot just before it touches the ground.

^Its stem is almost transparent, and its petals are so thin that the grass can be seen through them. Strange points of light drift across their surface, appearing and disappearing like tiny fragments of something you cannot quite remember.
^Only then do you realise that you had been about to step directly on it.

^Some are almost completely hidden beneath the grass. Others rise just above it, their translucent petals catching the faint light of the garden. A few seem to contain shifting shapes beneath their surfaces.
^When you're finally clear of that flower, she is smiling.
^"Good. Not many can avoid them; seems like Ossaneth chose well."
^You glance back at the flower you nearly crushed. "What are they?"
^She points towards one of the flowers.
^"Every flower is something it has seen. A place. A person. An experience. Sometimes something as insignificant as the colour of a wall."
^"And sometimes something it would never wish to forget."
^The flower beside your foot gives a faint pulse of light.
^For a fraction of a second, its petals reveal an image.
^You instinctively pull your foot farther away.
^"Yes," she says quietly. "Best not to disturb them."
^She gestures towards the clear ground beside her.
^"Come. There is plenty of room if you pay attention."
^You carefully pick your way through the garden.
^The Gardener waits for you to reach her.
^When you finally stand beside her, she gives you another small smile.
STOP: ^You stop moving in response to the Gardener's warning.
^"Ah." The Gardener smiles, though she keeps her hand raised. "No, dear. You can still come over here. Just be wary of those at your feet."
^She lowers her hand and gestures towards the ground between you.
^At first, you see only grass. Then, one of the blades moves. Beneath it, something pale and translucent catches the light.

^A flower grows there, though it is unlike any flower you have seen before. Its stem is almost impossibly thin, and its petals are translucent, their edges shimmering with a faint silver-green light. Tiny points of light drift lazily from its centre before fading into the air.
^"Yes." The Gardener's expression softens. "And very easily damaged."
^She steps carefully towards you, placing each foot between the flowers.
^"Memories." She continues. "Every one of these belongs to Ossaneth. Something it saw. Something it knows. Someone it knew."

^As you stare at the nearest flower, its petals briefly fill with colour. For an instant, you see something within it: an armillary sphere, a domed room beneath a black sky, then a gigantic eye. Watching 30<~>you.</~>
^"Sometimes." The Gardener smiles faintly. "Usually when they wish to."
^She turns towards the path. "Come. There is space beside me. Keep to the clear ground and you will be quite safe."
^You carefully make your way forward, watching the flowers as you go.
^The Gardener waits until you are beside her before continuing. "There we are."
